other_settings: Retain explicit Step 3A preprocessing and Harmony parameters; apply the same rule to all membership conditions and replicates.
acceptance: Final two outer objectives finite with nonzero previous objective, and absolute relative change < epsilon_harmony. Record signed change and native stop reason separately: the native 0.0.10 rule also accepts objective increases.
on_failure: Retain and label nonconverged output; exclude from primary paired conclusions, report missingness/failure count, and do not increase the iteration cap or tune parameters based on ARI. Any later amendment applies consistently before rerunning all affected conditions.
